A warm welcome from Pastor Daniel

Grace Royal Assembly is a Spirit-filled, Bible-centred family of more than 2,000 members, dedicated to helping every person know God, find freedom and fulfil their purpose.

When you walk through our doors, you are not a visitor for long. You are family. Whether you are exploring faith for the first time or looking for a church home, we are glad you found us. Join us this Sunday.

Pastor Daniel Adeyemi
Senior Pastor
